findings.reason: an assertion whose two sides both come from the code under test.
findings.text: assert rebuilt.pointer_rows() == incremental.pointer_rows() compares two outputs of the code under test on the same fixture, so it holds whatever the store does with pointer rows, including storing none at all; the row population is only pinned by the independent stream-name set on the next lines and by test_every_pointer_and_stream_is_ingested, so this assertion cannot name a condition under which it alone fails.

findings.reason: a context manager that reads as closing but only commits.
findings.text: with self._open_day(day) as day_connection commits the insert but never closes the day connection, because sqlite3.Connection's context manager is a transaction manager; the descriptor is released by refcount when the local goes out of scope, so a reader chasing a held day file is sent after the wrong lifetime and a non-refcounting caller would leak one connection per event.
